short: Good models for complex multiplication lattices

statements.markdown: Statement 6.1 (CM2). Let d be squarefree with d ≡ 3 (mod 4) and let L be a lattice √ with complex multiplication by Z[(1 + −d)/2]. For every prime ℓ ≥ 5 not dividing d and ∼ C ℓ there is ξ ̸ = 0 such that ξ 4 ιg 2 (L) and ξ 6 ιg 3 (L) are integral in every isomorphism ι : C = the maximal unramified extension of Q ℓ and the discriminant of the resulting Weierstrass equation is a unit.

lean.name: Formalism.L2.Th1.CM.CM2
lean.plain: Good models for complex multiplication lattices
lean.fidelity_note: The CM and prime hypotheses, fourth- and sixth-power rescaling, and unit discriminant agree. Lean places the integral invariants in the completion of the maximal unramified extension. The paper asks for them in the algebraic extension itself.
